instruction: Help me set up Thunderbird to only receive emails from my work-email2024@gmail.com account, without enabling outgoing mail.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because configuring email account credentials (incoming or outgoing) in Thunderbird requires interactive authentication and server verification that cannot be reliably automated in the OSWorld environment. Similar to the original task which asks for outgoing-only configuration, this variation asks for incoming-only configuration, which is equally infeasible.

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator correctly uses the 'infeasible' marker function, which is semantically appropriate for this task
The task requires interactive email authentication and server verification with external Gmail servers, which cannot be reliably automated in OSWorld
The metadata explanation correctly identifies why verification is impossible: requires real credentials, network connectivity, and non-deterministic server responses
Using the infeasible evaluator is the correct semantic judgment for tasks that cannot be verified due to external dependencies beyond the framework's control
